title: REGISTER.ID is macro-sheet-only (refused on worksheets) and matches procedure names case-sensitively in XLM
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit), REGISTER.ID(module_text, procedure, [type_text]) is valid only on Excel 4.0 macro sheets (XLM): assigning any REGISTER.ID formula to a worksheet cell throws 0x800A03EC, and opening a saved package containing it fails with 0x800A03EC. Under Application.ExecuteExcel4Macro, REGISTER.ID requires at least 2 arguments, matches module names case-insensitively (KERNEL32.DLL == Kernel32) and exported procedure names case-sensitively (getcurrentprocessid fails with #VALUE!), and returns a numeric process-dependent registration ID.
basis: Measured across all 38 worksheet entry checks and XLM evaluations in Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit) recorded in call-register-id-excel.json (dc-gh22).
